method: Boss-only animation starts (67), matched stops (68), same actor, skill and health band; >1s and <180s between starts. Health bands >70%, >40%, >10%, <=10% label phases, not exact split boundaries. Intervals can include interruptions; these are observed recurrence, not cooldowns or a guaranteed schedule. Normal mode excluded. No new targeting rules are inferred.

movement_geometry.method: All 471 CM/LCM indexed logs. Orb/Teleport: adjacent boss position samples <=650ms apart, >=700 units jump, within10s after cast. Charge: greatest direct displacement among positions in next10s, at least5samples. This charge window may include other movement. P4: actual facing updates after Final Form channel start, one aggregate per recording. Distances have sample uncertainty; not targeting or internal-AI proofs.
not_established: Exact Charge distance from this position-window method
Fixed P4 facing from post-channel facing updates (none available)

p2_spears.scope: 471 CM/LCM recordings. Complete patterns require22s followup and20 descending launches. Counts are aggregate; no player-level events included.

p4_spears.scope: Actual descending81176 missiles after Final Form channel. Waves grouped within100ms; relaunch alone is not a general block/destroy detector.

shared_warning_rounds.method: Vloxx-sourced warning effects, per-log GUIDs, marks grouped within1s; first mark defines round. P4 starts at Final Form channel81071. Earlier phases useHP bands. Missing target marks can shift warning timing or leave a missed round.

ascension_fixate.method: Full collection through 2026-10-19; 456 CM + 45 LCM. Aggregate-only findings. Local scripts audit_ascension_fixate.py, refine_ascension_audit.py, audit_ascension_exchange.py and audit_ascension_death.py retain private episode evidence outside the repository.

geometry_refresh_check.method: POV positive clean Geometry hit; exactly one matched 1000ms marker; available boons; no inferred ordinary strip; previous same-source/same-skill hit 20–1000ms earlier. Counts are hit observations, not unique casts.

ascension_fixate.fixate_immunity_correction: Same-phase reassignment subset recalculated using Damage Immunity 80608 in audit_fight_progression.py.

fight_progression.method: All indexed CM/LCM. Start P1 at first Vloxx combat-entry event. Damage Immunity 80608 reconstructed by stack ID; complete >=4s intervals grouped by recorded boss HP to identify 70/40/10% splits. Phase intervals run from split-immunity removal to the next split application. P4 begins at Final Form animation 81071; channel end follows immunity removal. Split completion additionally requires a following next-phase major cast within20s, or the Final Form channel at10%. Only complete recorded intervals contribute durations, including completed phases in later wipes; not kill-only pacing. Openings count first four selected major boss cast starts outside Damage Immunity, not every damage component. Normal mode excluded.

total_fights.method: Join complete P1, Split70, P2, Split40, P3, Split10 and P4-including-channel segments within each recording; sum within recording, then calculate median/min/max. Exclude recordings missing any segment.

boss_defiance_empowerment.method: All 501 CM/LCM recordings. Boss active defiance bar exits; strict subset has bar health <=10% within500ms before exit. Empowered81002 applications grouped within10ms, examined +/-500ms around recorded bar exit because state updates lag actual break. Other stack gains and overlaps retained.
